about.title: Serving the Ummah with Excellence
about.lead: Al-Saleem Integrated Transport Company is a licensed Saudi transport operator dedicated to carrying pilgrims and visitors in comfort, safety and dignity across the holy cities.
story: Every guest who comes to the Haramain is on a journey of a lifetime. We started Al-Saleem Transport with a simple conviction: that the road between the airport, the hotel and the sacred sites should be the easiest part of that journey - never a worry.

Today our vetted drivers and well-maintained vehicles serve guests across Makkah, Madinah, Jeddah and Taif, from a single airport pick-up to complete Ziyarat tours. We take pride in punctuality, transparent fares and the kind of care we would want for our own families.
about.mission: To give every pilgrim a calm, safe and dignified journey - so that transport is one less thing to think about, and worship can remain the focus.

faqPage.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqPage.subtitle: Clear answers about booking, pricing, coverage and your Ziyarat journey.

items.q: How do I book a ride?
items.a: The fastest way is WhatsApp. Use the booking form on our Book Now page or message +966 50 068 9196 directly with your pick-up, drop-off, date, time and number of passengers. We confirm your fare and vehicle within minutes.

We use fixed, transparent fares agreed before your trip - no meters and no hidden fees. The price depends on the route, vehicle type and number of passengers. Send us your trip details on WhatsApp for an exact quote.
We serve Makkah, Madinah, Jeddah and Taif, including airport and hotel transfers, and travel across the wider Kingdom of Saudi Arabia on request.

items.q: What types of vehicles do you have?
items.a: Sedans (1-3 passengers), SUVs (1-5), vans such as the Toyota Hiace (6-11) and coasters/buses (12+). All vehicles are clean, air-conditioned and well-maintained. Let us know your group size and luggage and we will recommend the right one.

items.q: Do you offer airport pick-up from Jeddah and Madinah?
items.a: Yes. We provide meet-and-greet airport transfers from Jeddah (King Abdulaziz International) and Madinah airports directly to your hotel in Makkah or Madinah, with flight tracking so we are there when you land.

items.q: Can you arrange a full Ziyarat tour?
items.a: Absolutely. We arrange guided Ziyarat tours of the blessed sites in Makkah, Madinah and Taif at an unhurried pace, with a driver who knows the sites and respects your time for prayer and reflection.

items.q: Are your drivers professional and licensed?
items.a: Yes. Our drivers are vetted, experienced and courteous, and we operate as a fully licensed Saudi transport company (License No. 35/00008116).
Payment arrangements are confirmed with you on WhatsApp when you book. We keep everything transparent and agreed in advance.
Plans change, especially during Umrah and Hajj. Please let us know as early as you can on WhatsApp and we will do our best to accommodate any change or cancellation.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how Al-Saleem Integrated Transport Company ("we", "us") handles information when you use our website or book our services.

sections.heading: Information we collect
sections.body: When you book a ride we collect the details you provide - such as your name, phone number, pick-up and drop-off locations, travel date and any notes. If you contact us via WhatsApp or email, we receive the information in those messages.

sections.heading: How we use your information
sections.body: We use your details only to arrange, confirm and provide your transport, to communicate with you about your booking, and to improve our service. We do not sell your personal information.

sections.heading: WhatsApp and messaging
sections.body: Bookings are typically completed over WhatsApp. Messages you send are also subject to WhatsApp's own privacy policy. We use the details in your message solely to serve your booking.

sections.heading: Cookies
sections.body: Our website uses a minimal cookie to remember your chosen language. We do not use it to track you across other websites.

sections.heading: Data retention
sections.body: We keep booking details only for as long as needed to provide the service and meet legal or accounting requirements, after which they are removed.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: You may ask us what information we hold about you and request that it be corrected or deleted. Contact us using the details below.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: For any privacy question, contact us on WhatsApp at +966 50 068 9196 or by email at info@alsaleemtransport.com.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These Terms govern your use of the Al-Saleem Integrated Transport Company website and services. By booking with us you agree to these Terms.

sections.heading: Our services
sections.body: We provide licensed passenger transport - airport transfers, hotel transfers, Ziyarat tours, Umrah and Hajj transport and intercity rides - across Makkah, Madinah, Jeddah, Taif and the wider Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

sections.heading: Bookings and fares
sections.body: Fares are fixed and agreed with you before travel. A booking is confirmed when we acknowledge your request. Please provide accurate pick-up details, timing and passenger numbers so we can serve you well.

sections.heading: Cancellations and changes
sections.body: If you need to change or cancel a booking, please tell us as early as possible on WhatsApp. We will always try to accommodate changes, especially during Umrah and Hajj.

sections.heading: Your responsibilities
sections.body: Please be ready at the agreed pick-up time and place, follow the driver's reasonable safety instructions, and treat the vehicle and driver with respect.

sections.heading: Liability
sections.body: We take great care to provide safe, punctual transport, but we are not responsible for delays caused by circumstances beyond our control such as traffic, weather, road closures or crowd conditions during peak seasons.

sections.heading: Governing law
sections.body: These Terms are governed by the laws of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: Questions about these Terms? Contact us on WhatsApp at +966 50 068 9196 or by email at info@alsaleemtransport.com.
